data.rule: When writing a launch line for an installed Python package, `uvx <name>` (or any index-resolving runner) is only the same program when the running install came from that index. Read the distribution's direct_url.json (PEP 610; present for VCS, local-directory, archive-URL and editable installs, absent for index installs) in the directory that holds the package, and for a non-index install name the installation itself by absolute path (its console script beside sys.executable, else the interpreter with -m). The presence of uvx on PATH says nothing about where the package lives.
data.title: Decide how to launch an installed package from its install provenance (PEP 610 direct_url.json), not from whether a runner like uvx is on PATH
